{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (invalid sentinel)
df_valid_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = df_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age of customers with valid age: {mean_age}')"}
